exact_structure: 405 forced-zero hot coordinates plus 12-fold repetition of the binary cycle code H1 of the GQ(4,2) Levi graph on its 135 incidence edges

layers: 405 hot singleton checks plus alternating repetition-chain half

decoder.algorithm: Set the 405 forced-zero hot bits to zero. For each 12-fold cold block let a_e be the number of received ones and c_e=12-2a_e. Let N be the negative-cost Levi edges and T=boundary(N). Maximum-likelihood decoding is exactly a minimum-weight T-join on the 72-vertex Levi graph with weights |c_e|, followed by symmetric difference with N.

theorem: The binary GQ(4,2) Levi-homology code is exactly a zero-hot plus twelvefold-repeated Levi cycle code. It has 1080 minimum weight-96 words, a rank-1961 sparse dual, an explicit four-layer syndrome schedule, and an exact minimum-T-join decoder correcting every arbitrary error pattern of weight at most 47.
boundary: The four-layer schedule is an explicit construction, not claimed globally minimum. The decoder is exact for the classical binary code; no physical fault-tolerance threshold is inferred.
execution: Exact incidence/cell algebra frozen independently; analysis/w33_pass4829_levi_code_corrected.py regenerates the objectwise repetition blocks, 8-cycle shell, sparse dual basis, and schedule.
